It now looks for paths under ".iaso/log/" and checks the log's local kinds itself to decide what to commit.; You want old log entries compacted at each merge into main. You also decided (DEC-195) that the log module stages what the compaction moved and that the landing job never names the log folder. The requirement still says exactly this, so the record is right and the code has drifted from it.

The landing job's commit step now does this itself. It looks for paths under ".iaso/log/" and uses the log module's lists of tracked and local kinds to decide which moved entries go into the tidy commit. The reason for the change is sound: a new segment for a kind kept on this machine only is ignored by git, and naming that segment would make the whole commit fail. That fix is also what EX-16 needs. But it is in the wrong place. The check belongs inside the log module, for example in its staging step or in a helper that returns the paths to commit. The landing job should not mention the log folder at all.

Your latest message before this change was about a separate debug fix and did not ask for this. The fix is to move the filter into the log module and keep the same behaviour.
